messages:
Asha: quick game: you have to eat the exact same meal for 7 days. one meal only, no variations. what are you locking in?
Diego: sushi bowl. can we count different fish as the same meal? :shrug:
Asha: rules: same meal. toppings/flavors no, but presentation allowed.
Priya: greek salad. light and easy. olives forever. :olive:
Jon: cheesy pasta. carbs are a personality trait.
Leah: breakfast sandwich. egg + cheese + something. portable.
meme-bot: Friday vibes -> https://giphy.com/gifs/food-weekend-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 :popcorn:
Diego: pasta is tempting but will it be soul-crushing by day 5?
Priya: salad keeps you functional. not glamorous but steady.
Jon: honest answer: leftover cereal. put milk in a thermos.
Asha: poll: drop one emoji for the meal you'd choose (i'll tally).
Diego: :sushi:
Priya: :salad:
Jon: :spaghetti:
Leah: :egg:
Asha: tally after 2 minutes -> sushi 1, salad 1, pasta 1, breakfast 1. shockingly even.
Leah: side challenge: what's the one condiment you could never lose for this week?
Priya: tahini. dramatic but essential.
Jon: hot sauce. every meal deserves it.
Diego: soy sauce. obviously.
Asha: OK this settled nothing but my rent is paid in curiosity. also lol at Jon's cereal thermos.
meme-bot: Reminder: free snacks in the kitchen on Tue. :tada:
